There are three Frost Wurm Young in the last level of Frostmaw's Burrows. Approaching them causes [[Frost Wurm Larvae]] to pop up near them. Once you have killed these groups 3 [[Frost Siege Wurm]]s, 2 [[Frostmaw Spawn]]s, and [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]] will spawn.
